title: Bind semantic delta bodies to the approval that signed them
description: Bind semantic delta bodies to the approval that signed them
acceptance_criteria: A semantic delta body swapped after approval is refused before it rewrites the canonical spec, and the refusal names the module
An untouched approved delta still materializes into the canonical spec exactly as before
An approval that records no delta digest — every archived change in this repository — proceeds, because absent evidence is unknown and not a violation
